title: War Begins
summary: The Abyssal Gate beneath Gangnam Station tears open into the human world. As thousands of demonic beasts pour into Seoul, Ha-Jun and the unified Hunter Bureau draw the battle line at the Gate's threshold.

panels.shot: gangnam station intersection wide shot
panels.action: The bustling neon crossroads of Gangnam Station torn open by a 200-foot glowing crater of black-and-purple void.
panels.prose_en: The bustling neon crossroads of Gangnam Station torn open by a 200-foot glowing crater of black-and-purple void.
panels.prose_hi: Gangnam station ka halchal bhara nean chauraha kale aur baingani rang ke 200 foot ke chamakte gaddhe se fat gaya.

panels.shot: abandoned cars overturned and burning
panels.action: Taxis and luxury sedans tossed aside like toys; streetlamps flickering with demonic static interference.
panels.prose_en: Taxis and luxury sedans tossed aside like toys; streetlamps flickering with demonic static interference.
panels.prose_hi: Taxiyan aur luxury sedan khilaunon ki tarah ek taraf fenk di gain; shaitani demonic sthaitik hastkshep ke saath timtimate street lamp.

panels.shot: hundreds of abyssal imps swarming from crater
panels.action: Feral, three-eyed Abyssal Imps with obsidian scales and acidic fangs pour out like a black tidal wave.
panels.prose_en: Feral, three-eyed Abyssal Imps with obsidian scales and acidic fangs pour out like a black tidal wave.
panels.prose_hi: Obseedian tarazu aur amleey nukile daanton ke saath jangli, teen aankhon wale abisal imps ek kale jwar ki lahar ki tarah nikalte han.

panels.shot: united convoy arriving with drifting tires
panels.action: Ha-Jun's van and six Bureau armored carriers drift violently around the corner into battle formation.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's van and six Bureau armored carriers drift violently around the corner into battle formation.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki van aur chhah bureau bakhtarband vahak yudh ki taiyari mein kone ke charon or hinsak roop se bahte han.

panels.shot: captain baek leaping off moving vehicle
panels.action: Captain Baek hits the asphalt running, drawing the Eclipse Greatsword in a single thunderous arc.

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: PERIMETER SHIELD! HOLD THE LINE FOR THE HOSTAGES!

panels.prose_en: Captain Baek hits the asphalt running, drawing the Eclipse Greatsword in a single thunderous arc.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bak daudte hue damar se takrata hai aur ek hi gadgdahat wale chaap mein aclips gratusward ko khinchta hai.

panels.shot: hunters deploying energy barricades
panels.action: Bureau operatives slam heavy kinetic barriers into the asphalt, forming a glowing blue defensive line.
panels.prose_en: Bureau operatives slam heavy kinetic barriers into the asphalt, forming a glowing blue defensive line.
panels.prose_hi: Buro sanchalak bhari gatij badhaon ko damar par patak dete han, jisse ek chamakdar neeli rakshatmak rekha ban jaati hai.

panels.shot: van door sliding open
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps down onto the shattered asphalt, cloaked in black, his dual-ringed eyes illuminating the dark rain.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps down onto the shattered asphalt, cloaked in black, his dual-ringed eyes illuminating the dark rain.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun toote hue damar par utarta hai, kale kapde pahane hue, uski dohri ring wali aankhen andheri baarish ko roshan kar rahi han.

panels.shot: kuro landing on ha-jun shoulder flaring feathers
panels.action: Kuro looks down into the chasm: 'The Gate of Gehenna... Section 9 ke theek center mein open hua hai.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Tae-Jun is chasm ke andar hai... Aur uske theek peeche Rare Relic hai!

panels.prose_en: Kuro looks down into the chasm: 'The Gate of Gehenna... Section 9 ke theek center mein open hua hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro neeche khai mein dekhta hai: 'gehena ka gate... section 9 ke theek center mein khula hua hai.'

panels.shot: min-jae handing ha-jun wireless comms earpiece
panels.action: Min-Jae presses an earpiece into Ha-Jun's ear: 'Main satellite feeds se tumhara path guide karunga!'

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Safe wapas aana, Ha-Jun... Dono bhaiyon ko zinda wapas aana hai!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae presses an earpiece into Ha-Jun's ear: 'Main satellite feeds se tumhara path guide karunga!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne Ha-Jun ke kaan mein ek yearpis dabaya: 'main satellite feed se tumhara path guide karunga!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun clasping min-jae hand
panels.action: Ha-Jun nods firmly: 'Zinda wapas aaunga, Min-Jae. Bureau ki command sambhalo.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun nods firmly: 'Zinda wapas aaunga, Min-Jae. Bureau ki command sambhalo.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun dridhta se sir hilata hai: 'jinda wapas aaunga, min-je. bureau ki command sambhalo.'

panels.shot: colossal 25-foot abyssal gorefiend climbing from rift
panels.action: A titanic Gorefiend with four arms, a boar skull face, and burning magma veins drags itself onto the street.
panels.prose_en: A titanic Gorefiend with four arms, a boar skull face, and burning magma veins drags itself onto the street.
panels.prose_hi: Char bhujaon wala, suar ki khopdi wala chehra aur jalti hui magma shiraon wala ek titanic gorfiyend sadak par ghasitata hua aata hai.

panels.shot: gorefiend swinging colossal iron club at hunters
panels.action: The monster swings a six-ton spiked iron club directly at the Hunter defensive line.
panels.prose_en: The monster swings a six-ton spiked iron club directly at the Hunter defensive line.
panels.prose_hi: Rakshs hunter rakshatmak rekha par sidhe chhah ton ka nukila lohe ka club ghumata hai.

panels.shot: captain baek bracing with greatsword to block
panels.action: Baek braces his greatsword two-handed, knowing the blow will shatter his exo-suit.
panels.prose_en: Baek braces his greatsword two-handed, knowing the blow will shatter his exo-suit.
panels.prose_hi: Bek ne apni mahan talwar ko do hathon se pakad liya, yah jaante hue ki jhatka uske exo-suit ko chaknachur kar dega.

panels.shot: ha-jun blurring in front of baek like violet lightning
panels.action: Ha-Jun materializes in midair between the iron club and Baek, his left bone gauntlet raised.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun materializes in midair between the iron club and Baek, his left bone gauntlet raised.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun lohe ke club aur bak ke beech hawa mein sakar hota hai, uski bayin haddi ka kavach upar utha hua hai.

panels.shot: one-handed bone gauntlet catch
panels.action: Ha-Jun catches the six-ton spiked club with his bare left bone gauntlet; the shockwave cracks the street for 50 feet.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun catches the six-ton spiked club with his bare left bone gauntlet; the shockwave cracks the street for 50 feet.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne chhah ton ke nukile club ko apni nangi bayin haddi ke dastaane se pakda; shockwev se sadak 50 feet tak toot jaati hai.

panels.shot: gorefiend four eyes bulging in shock
panels.action: The colossal monster's four eyes bulge in absolute disbelief as a 17-year-old human stops its blow cold.
panels.prose_en: The colossal monster's four eyes bulge in absolute disbelief as a 17-year-old human stops its blow cold.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal rakshas ki char aankhen puri tarah se avishvas mein ubhar aati han, jaise hi ek 17 saal ka manav apni thandi maar ko rokta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up with cold sovereign smile
panels.action: Ha-Jun's dual eyes burn with radiant majesty: 'Mere shehar mein... tumhara koi hak nahi hai.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: You picked the wrong city, demon.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's dual eyes burn with radiant majesty: 'Mere shehar mein... tumhara koi hak nahi hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki dohri aankhen deeptimaan mahima se jalti han: 'mere shahar men... tumhara koi haq nahin hai.'

panels.shot: ha-jun flexing fingers to crush the iron club
panels.action: With a simple squeeze of his bone fingers, the solid cast-iron club shatters like chalk into powder.
panels.prose_en: With a simple squeeze of his bone fingers, the solid cast-iron club shatters like chalk into powder.
panels.prose_hi: Uski haddi ki ungaliyon ke ek sadharan nichod ke sath, thos kaccha loha club chak ki tarah powder mein bikhar jata hai.

panels.shot: summoning massive flaming blood blade
panels.action: Ha-Jun draws a 10-foot colossal blade of solid crystalline blood, engulfed in roaring violet hellfire.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun draws a 10-foot colossal blade of solid crystalline blood, engulfed in roaring violet hellfire.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun thos crystaliy khoon ka 10 foot ka vishal blade khinchta hai, jo garjanshil baingani narkankaal mein ghira hua hai.

panels.shot: vertical upward slash cleaving gorefiend
panels.action: Ha-Jun swings upward with a devastating celestial crescent; the 25-foot titan is cleaved clean in two.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun swings upward with a devastating celestial crescent; the 25-foot titan is cleaved clean in two.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek vinashkari khagoliya ardhchandra ke saath upar ki or jhulta hai; 25 foot ka titan do hisson mein banta hua hai.

panels.shot: gorefiend bursting into violet firework of embers
panels.action: The colossal demon detonates into a magnificent fountain of violet embers and golden mana particles.
panels.prose_en: The colossal demon detonates into a magnificent fountain of violet embers and golden mana particles.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal danav baingani angaron aur sunhare maina kanon ke ek shandar favvare mein visfot karta hai.

panels.shot: hundreds of imps freezing in collective terror
panels.action: Seeing their champion obliterated in two seconds, the hundreds of lesser demons scramble back in panic.
panels.prose_en: Seeing their champion obliterated in two seconds, the hundreds of lesser demons scramble back in panic.
panels.prose_hi: Apne champion ko do second mein nasht hote dekh, saikadon chhote rakshas ghabrakar wapas bhag gaye.

panels.shot: hunters erupting in deafening cheers
panels.action: Fifty hardened Bureau hunters raise their fists, shouting in wild, triumphant celebration.
panels.prose_en: Fifty hardened Bureau hunters raise their fists, shouting in wild, triumphant celebration.
panels.prose_hi: Pachas kathor bureau shikari apni mutthiyan upar uthate han, jangli, vijayi utsav mein chillate han.

panels.shot: captain baek saluting ha-jun with fist over heart
panels.action: Captain Baek strikes his chestplate in a formal military salute: 'The path is yours, Ha-Jun. We will hold the gate surface!'

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Bahar ka ek bhi demon aage nahi badhega! Apne bhai ko le aao!

panels.prose_en: Captain Baek strikes his chestplate in a formal military salute: 'The path is yours, Ha-Jun. We will hold the gate surface!'.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bake ne aupcharik sainya salami mein apni chestaplate par prahar kiya: 'rasta tumhara hai, Ha-Jun. hum gate ki satah ko pakdenge!'

panels.shot: ha-jun walking to the edge of the abyss crater
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands on the crumbling edge of the 200-foot void chasm, staring down into the glowing abyss.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands on the crumbling edge of the 200-foot void chasm, staring down into the glowing abyss.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun 200 foot ki shunya khai ke dhahte kinare par khada hai, aur neeche chamakti khai ko dekh raha hai.

panels.shot: kuro expanding into shadow glider form
panels.action: Kuro wraps his wings around Ha-Jun's back, forming a sleek set of aerodynamic obsidian shadow gliders.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Beyond this point... Mortal laws exist nahi karti.

panels.prose_en: Kuro wraps his wings around Ha-Jun's back, forming a sleek set of aerodynamic obsidian shadow gliders.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne apne pankhon ko Ha-Jun ki peeth ke charon or lapet diya, jisse vayugatikiy obsidian chhaya glider ka ek chikna set ban gaya.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking down into glowing subterranean kingdom
panels.action: Deep beneath the crater, ancient obsidian towers and floating crystalline islands of the Abyss loom.
panels.prose_en: Deep beneath the crater, ancient obsidian towers and floating crystalline islands of the Abyss loom.
panels.prose_hi: Crater ke niche, prachin obsidian tower aur abis ke tairte crystaliy dweep dikhai dete han.

panels.shot: sovereign quest interface flashing golden tier update
panels.action: The Sovereign Interface updates with blinding diamond-tier gothic lettering.

dialogue.text:
[ARC 4 CONCLUDED: THE DEMON HUNTER WAR]
[ENTERING ARC 5: THE ABYSSAL KINGDOM]
Primary Objective: Infiltrate Section 9 & Rescue Kang Tae-Jun.
Secondary Objective: Claim Relic #5: The Fang of Abyss.

panels.prose_en: The Sovereign Interface updates with blinding diamond-tier gothic lettering.
panels.prose_hi: Soweren interface chamakdar dimand-stariy gothic aksharon ke saath adyatan hota hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun diving headfirst into the abyss chasm
panels.action: Ha-Jun plunges off the precipice into the vertical purple void, cutting through the clouds like a fallen comet.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun plunges off the precipice into the vertical purple void, cutting through the clouds like a fallen comet.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek gire hue dhumketu ki tarah baadalon ko kaatate hue, chattan se udhrvadhar baingani shunya mein gir jata hai.

panels.shot: dual-ringed eyes glowing in the deep abyss darkness
panels.action: Surrounded by ancient ruins and demonic lightning in the depths, Ha-Jun's eyes shine like twin unyielding stars.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main aa raha hoon, Bhai. Ab hum dono mil kar is duniya ko badlenge.

panels.prose_en: Surrounded by ancient ruins and demonic lightning in the depths, Ha-Jun's eyes shine like twin unyielding stars.
panels.prose_hi: Prachin khandharon aur gahrai mein shaitani demonic bijli se ghire Ha-Jun ki aankhen judwan adig sitaron ki tarah chamakti han.
